title: How visual information explains variance in visual perspective at autobiographical retrieval
title_zh: 视觉信息如何解释自传性回忆中视觉视角的方差
abstract: Variance in visual perspective during autobiographical retrieval has received considerable attention. This phenomenon refers to the capacity to recall past events from a first-person visual perspective, a third-person visual perspective, or even multiple perspectives. Although many studies have identified factors that correlate with this variance at retrieval, significantly less effort has been devoted to constructing a model that integrates and explains these various correlations. This paper aims to address this gap by integrating two previous models into a single one, the visual information for perspective at autobiographical retrieval model, according to which variance in visual and abstract information serves as a unifying factor that explains this perspectival variance. In addition to introducing this model and presenting evidence in its support, the paper also argues for the relevance of constructing such explanatory models in neuroscientific research.
abstract_zh: 自传性回忆过程中视觉视角的方差已受到相当多关注。该现象指的是从第一人称视觉视角、第三人称视觉视角，甚至多重视角回忆过去事件的能力。虽然许多研究已识别出与回忆时方差相关的因素，但针对整合并解释这些相关性的模型的构建工作显著不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，将两种先前模型整合为一个单一模型——自传性回忆视角的视觉信息模型，该模型认为视觉信息与抽象信息的方差是解释视角方差的统一因素。除介绍该模型并提供支持证据外，本文还论证了在神经科学研究中构建此类解释性模型的相关性。
